references.text: Another legal provision in Numbers 4, also introduced with the expression 'statute of judgment' (חֻקַּת מִשְׁפָּט), which is to apply for all generations.
The expression 'a perpetual statute for you throughout your generations' reflects the same principle of laws that are to remain permanently in force for Israel's descendants.
Uses a similar formulation about 'a perpetual statute throughout your generations, wherever you live' (בְּכֹל מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם).
Contains the same expression 'in all your dwellings' (בְּכֹל מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם) and 'for your generations' (לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם).
A perpetual statute to be observed throughout all generations, wherever the Israelites live.
The conclusion of the same legal chapter concerning cities of refuge, explaining the basis for these laws.
Introduction to statutes (מִשְׁפָּטִים) that Moses is to present to the people.
